FOCUS_LOCKED_GLOBAL: Buy Focused Farming once in Player Upgrades to farm any discovered enemy.
FOCUS_GLOBAL_BENEFIT: Farm any discovered enemy spot, on every map.
FOCUS_GLOBAL_OWNED: Owned: tap Farm on any discovered enemy.
HELP_LANDING_INTRO: Pick a topic or read every guide in order. Reading changes nothing in your game.
HELP_DISCOVERY_BASIC: Want more help? Open Settings → Help & Tutorials. Pick a topic or read all 14 guides.
HELP_DISCOVERY_GUIDED: Need a reminder later? Open Settings → Help & Tutorials for a guide to every system.
HELP_DISCOVERY_CHOOSER: You can explore Help & Tutorials anytime in Settings.
HELP_CARD_MOVEMENT_COMBAT_ACTION: Drag the joystick to approach an enemy.
HELP_CARD_MOVEMENT_COMBAT_SUPPORT: Your hero automatically attacks enemies within reach.
HELP_CARD_MANUAL_TARGET_ACTION: Drag from your hero to an enemy, then release.
HELP_CARD_MANUAL_TARGET_SUPPORT: Use this gesture to change who your hero attacks.
HELP_CARD_COLLECT_EQUIP_ACTION: Collect dropped gear, then equip it.
HELP_CARD_COLLECT_EQUIP_SUPPORT: Equipment strengthens you; stored gear also grants bonuses.
HELP_CARD_MERGE_GEAR_ACTION: Merge two copies of the same item.
HELP_CARD_MERGE_GEAR_SUPPORT: Merging increases the item's strength and merge rank.
HELP_CARD_PLAYER_UPGRADES_ACTION: Buy upgrades to strengthen your hero.
HELP_CARD_PLAYER_UPGRADES_SUPPORT: Focused Farming unlocks globally for 25 Gems here.
HELP_CARD_ENEMY_AUTOMATION_ACTION: Upgrade each enemy type to automate its loot.
HELP_CARD_ENEMY_AUTOMATION_SUPPORT: Auto-Collect, Auto-Merge and Auto-Evolution are type-specific.
HELP_CARD_MISSIONS_ACTION: Follow a mission and claim its completed reward.
HELP_CARD_MISSIONS_SUPPORT: Missions give you goals and additional resources.
HELP_CARD_EXPLORE_CAMPS_ACTION: Discover camps, then select your destination on the map.
HELP_CARD_EXPLORE_CAMPS_SUPPORT: Unlock camps to travel and choose where you respawn.
HELP_CARD_SKILLS_SUPPLIES_ACTION: Equip skills and supplies before tougher fights.
HELP_CARD_SKILLS_SUPPLIES_SUPPORT: Skills assist combat; supplies can heal or grant boosts.
HELP_CARD_OFFLINE_REWARDS_ACTION: Claim rewards when you return to the game.
HELP_CARD_OFFLINE_REWARDS_SUPPORT: Offline upgrades unlock more reward categories.
HELP_CARD_WEAPON_EVOLUTION_ACTION: Meet the merge and copy requirements to evolve a weapon.
HELP_CARD_WEAPON_EVOLUTION_SUPPORT: Evolution advances a weapon to a stronger tier.
HELP_CARD_PRESTIGE_ACTION: Defeat the Snowman and complete Prestige opportunities.
HELP_CARD_PRESTIGE_SUPPORT: Prestige grants permanent cards when you reset your run.
HELP_CARD_MAP_DETAILS_MASTERY_ACTION: Explore maps and purchase Map Details to learn more.
HELP_CARD_MAP_DETAILS_MASTERY_SUPPORT: Map Mastery tracks lasting exploration and achievements.
HELP_CARD_ADVANCED_FARMING_ACTION: Choose a discovered spot and tap Farm.
HELP_CARD_ADVANCED_FARMING_SUPPORT: Move manually to stop farming or choose another spot.
GUIDE_TARGET_STRIKE_DETAIL: Your hero walks to the enemy you chose and attacks it.
GUIDE_AUTO_ATTACK_DETAIL: Your hero now attacks nearby enemies automatically. Drag from your hero to an enemy whenever you want to change targets.
